approval_items.title: System Outage Escalation – Urgent Customer Impact
approval_items.reason: Incoming signal indicates an urgent system outage escalation requiring immediate acknowledgment and a clear next-step commitment to the affected customer.

source.subject: URGENT: System Outage – Immediate Assistance Required

proposed_action.subject: Re: URGENT: System Outage – Immediate Assistance Required
proposed_action.body:
Hi,

Thank you for reaching out, and I'm sorry you're experiencing this right now — I understand how disruptive this is.

Our team is actively looking into this and has made it a top priority. We'll have a meaningful update back to you within the next 60 minutes.

If anything changes or escalates further in the meantime, please reply directly to this email and we'll respond immediately.

We appreciate your patience and take full accountability for getting this resolved as quickly as possible.

Warm regards,
Deconstruct Support Team

xai_explanation.trigger_rationale: The upstream workflow flagged this message under the 'Urgent' priority tier, explicitly associated with 'system outages' and 'escalations'. The keywords 'system outage', 'urgent', and 'escalation' are direct matches to high-severity routing rules.
xai_explanation.strategy_rationale: An outage affecting a customer warrants immediate empathetic acknowledgment, a concrete timeline for the next update, and a clear escalation path. No root cause, resolution status, or compensation details have been invented — only a 60-minute update commitment aligned with the batch intelligence SLA estimate.

approval_items.title: High-Priority Customer Complaint – Escalation Required
approval_items.reason: Three high-priority complaint emails were identified in the batch. This draft addresses the complaint category collectively, requiring human review before sending to ensure the correct recipient and specific details are confirmed.

proposed_action.subject: Re: Complaint – Service Not Meeting Expectations
proposed_action.body:
Hi,

Thank you for taking the time to share your concerns — I'm sorry the experience hasn't met your expectations, and I want to make sure we address this properly.

Your feedback has been escalated to the right team and is being reviewed now. Someone will be in touch with you directly within one business day to discuss the specifics and agree on next steps.

We value your relationship with us and are committed to making this right.

Kind regards,
Deconstruct Support Team

xai_explanation.trigger_rationale: The batch summary explicitly lists 'Complaints' under the High priority tier with a count of 3. The keywords 'complaint', 'high priority', and 'escalation' triggered this flag. SLA risk is elevated because unaddressed complaints at this volume can breach response commitments.
xai_explanation.strategy_rationale: The draft acknowledges the customer's frustration directly, avoids making specific promises about outcomes or compensation, and sets a realistic one-business-day follow-up expectation. No incident details or resolution status have been fabricated.
